comparator: reference native state; eta arms share the same reference
budget: Eight fixed roots, four eta arms, at most eight proposals per arm; no future rollouts
selection_rule: Among eta values with maximal accepted-pair root coverage, choose the largest; inspect effective state displacement without reading future rewards.
stopping_rule: Exhaust the fixed development subset; no resampling to fill coverage. R3 collection uses roots8..127 after eta is locked.
